# config: git: enable --update-refs by default

Set `rebase.updateRefs true` so that rebasing a stack of dependent branches moves the intermediate branch refs along (Git 2.38's `--update-refs`, explained in [Andrew Lock's post](https://andrewlock.net/working-with-stacked-branches-in-git-is-easier-with-update-refs/)). It is the git-native part of stacked-branch workflows ([#499](DOT-441.md)).
